Sandbox_LWT_PumpFlowMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplies the litres a pump gives every 10 minutes (50 L for a pond pump at 1.0).
Sandbox_LWT_FilterCapacityMultiplier_too: Multiplies the litres a filter cartridge cleans before it is worn out (500 L at 1.0).
Sandbox_LWT_PumpWearMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplies the efficiency a pump loses while it runs (about a week of running from 100%% to 0%% at 1.0; 0 = no wear). Below 20%% it may break down.
Sandbox_LWT_InletRange_tooltip: How far (in squares) from a house water inlet the plumbed fixtures of its building get water, up to 3 floors above it.
Sandbox_LWT_BaseRange_tooltip: Away from a map building (a base you built), how far (in squares) a house water inlet serves the plumbed fixtures, up to 3 floors above it.
Sandbox_LWT_WasherFix_tooltip: On a server, the washing machines fed by a house water inlet show their real state to the players: plumbed, and stopped when they run out of water.
Sandbox_LWT_SprinklerRadiusMultiplier_to: Multiplies how far a sprinkler waters the plants (2 squares at 1.0, 10 at most).
Sandbox_LWT_SprinklerTimerMin_tooltip: Fewest hours a player may set between two waterings of an automatic sprinkler.
Sandbox_LWT_SprinklerTimerMax_tooltip: Most hours a player may set between two waterings of an automatic sprinkler.
Sandbox_LWT_FillContainers: Containers a barrel fitting may fill
Sandbox_LWT_FillContainers_tooltip: Names of entity scripts or sprites, separated by ; (water coolers: WaterDispenser). They are filled through a barrel fitting set to Fill, whatever their size, with clean water only. Barrels and rain collectors always work.
